# swampworks

**Swamp workflows, extensions, and experiments.**

Swampworks is my workshop for learning, building, and experimenting with
[Swamp](https://swamp.club/).
## Extensions

Each top-level directory with a `manifest.yaml` is a swamp extension. This
table is kept up to date by the
[README workflow](.github/workflows/readme.yml).
